If you’re starting a business and only using Alibaba, you need to know about 1688! 🇨🇳 Alibaba is built for international buyers, while 1688 is primarily for China’s domestic wholesale market. That means you can often find lower prices, more suppliers and products you might not see on Alibaba. But here’s the catch: 1688 isn’t necessarily cheaper once you factor in shipping, payment arrangements, sourcing agents and quality control. My advice? Compare BOTH before placing your order. No te dejes llevar por el precio más barato: si una oferta parece demasiado buena para ser verdad, investiga. ✅ 4. Solicita muestras: verifica la calidad antes de invertir en grandes cantidades. ✅ 5. Pide una videollamada: solicita ver la fábrica, los productos y las instalaciones. ✅ 6.
